title: Cache Basics
description: Understand how Apollo Client's cache works.

data.text: Apollo Client's **InMemoryCache** normalizes and caches data automatically. Understanding how it works is key to efficient data management.
The cache normalizes data by splitting it into individual objects keyed by `__typename:id`. This ensures consistency across queries.

data.title: Normalization
data.content: How data is normalized in cache

data.title: Type Policies
Cache Key
data.text: Objects must have __typename and id (or _id) to be normalized. Use dataIdFromObject for custom keys.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Understanding the cache is essential for Apollo.
